elaine (pm): Quick thread — need a single canonical "isolation ladder" that sales can show customers: pricing tiers, expected latency bands, and cutover safety. Can we put a shortlist together by EOD?

sandeep (eng-plat): Suggest 4 tiers: shared, burst-reserve (soft tokens), reserved-pool (hard reserved), private. For each tier we should publish: SLI targets, billing model, migration window, and abort criteria.

greta (infra): Two implementation patterns for reserved: carved pools vs reservation tokens. Carved pools = deterministic isolation; tokens = faster rollout. We'll produce warm-buffer recommendations per tenant profile.

omar (sre): Ops priorities: automated chaos scenarios for eviction, a rollback plan that removes reservations and returns traffic to shared, and alerting for cross-region spill > X%. Abort if user error spike >0.5% or p99 > 2x baseline.

nina (sales): Customers (BankEdge + MediPlus) want a one-pager mapping price multiplier -> delta in expected p95/p99 and an example invoice. Sales also wants a migration credit option and a short sales script.

research-bot: Publishing compat appendix tomorrow: model_variant -> recommended lane and expected quality delta when falling back.

sandeep (eng-plat): API sketch for ladder entry:
```
redwood ladder add --tenant bankedge --tier reserved-pool --capacity 512GB --regions eu-west-1 --warm-buffer 4
```
Console should show estimated monthly delta and warm-buffer cost.

billing-bot: Billing hooks required: per-tenant quota enforcement with <=60s enforcement window, invoice preview endpoint, and overage tiers. Finance to define bands.

greta (infra): Action: run cost-sims for three tenant profiles and recommend warm-buffer SKUs. Will post results to /shared/cost-sims/2850001234.

omar (sre): I'll draft the chaos matrix and automated rollback scripts. Also requesting a telemetry event: "lane.fallback" with fields (tenant, fallback_model, region, latency_ms) so quality and billing can correlate.

sandeep (eng-plat): Add quality gate: fallback eval on a prompt set; require delta < 3% on key metrics or disable automatic fallback.

elaine (pm): I'll draft the decision doc with ladder, gates, owners, and a small SLA-calculator embed (price vs expected tail). Review by Thu noon. Ping me with missing risks.
